proposed_fixes.title: Recover the Settings window launched from the tray

plan: Reproduce double-click and context-menu Settings separately and determine whether Quick Access, the context menu, and Settings process appear.
Trace the Settings menu command through open_settings_window and correct the launch/reuse/foreground path only if that command fails.
Add a tray-to-Settings regression that covers an existing Settings process and a fresh launch.
verification: Choosing Settings from the tray context menu opens or foregrounds the Settings window.
Double-click continues to honor the configured Quick Access behavior.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting this on the 0.102.3001 Microsoft Store build and attaching a bug report. The tray double-click and the context-menu Settings command follow different paths in the current source. Could you test them separately and describe what appears for each—whether Quick Access opens, the context menu appears, and whether a Settings window/process starts? This will distinguish an expected double-click action from a failed Settings launch.
